about_the_game:
Raiders Rise is a FULL-Coop PvP Bullet Heaven game! Band together with your crew of daring space raiders, descend onto hostile planets, and dig deep for priceless crystals. The world of Raiders Rise is so perilous that sometimes survival means teaming up with rival raiders… until one of you decides not to…

Discover FULL Coop: with allies, and enemies

The galaxy’s richest crystal veins lie in the deadliest places. Crews must work together to overcome traps, storms, and hostile wildlife, but rival raiders are never far behind. Will you form uneasy truces, or sabotage your enemies to steal their haul? Greed makes allies fragile.

A Crew of Unique Raiders

Choose your raider from a diverse roster of specialists, each with their own tools, abilities, and combat style. Engineers handle the heavy lifting, tanks hold the line, and damage dealers unleash chaos on enemy raiders. Every role matters, and every raider brings a new way to play.

Play With Friends, Compete for Fun

Jump into fast-paced multiplayer matches with your friends. Competitive, but lighthearted—perfect for laughing, experimenting, and enjoying the ride together while pulling off wild stunts and cause just enough chaos to keep things interesting.

What comes next?

Your raids shape the galaxy

Raid for one of the six mighty Houses battle for power, but choose wisely: in Raiders Rise, the actions of the entire community shape the universe and how it evolves, crowning new rulers, dooming old empires, and rewriting the future.

Each season introduces new raiders, planets, hazards, and gear to expand your adventures. Push deeper, discover stranger worlds, and uncover rare artifacts that change the way you play. The galaxy is vast, dangerous, and always evolving — only the boldest raiders will rise.

Join Us

Our community lives on Discord, where you can share feedback, report bugs, or just hang out with fellow raiders. Early adopters might even score exclusive goodies—designed with your input, of course.

Ready to raid? Buckle up for a journey full of strategy, chaos, and galactic shenanigans!

name: Raiders Rise

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bits
  • Processor: A quad-core Intel i5 4th gen or AMD FX equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 (2 GB VRAM, DX11 support)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum requirements for playing at 720p@30fps
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bits
  • Processor: Intel I7-8700K or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended requirements for playing at 1080p@60fps

short_description: Raiders Rise is a FULL-Coop PvPvE Bullet Heaven game where two teams must cooperate and compete to collect crystals. Survive alien threats, outmaneuver rivals, and choose: help or betray? In this chaotic battleground, teamwork is key… until it isn’t.
